classes.label: Red Hat configiq (scored by simulation)
classes.note: Red Hat's configiq dataset (CC BY 4.0), aggregates of GuideLLM runs scored by simulation: a unit is simulated as a closed loop at its recorded concurrency and request count, with the substitutions named on each point. Provisional: launcher-consistent rows only, capped at G3, outside the regular headline. TTFT and ITL are GuideLLM's means; ITL is the per-request time per output token after the first (the InferenceX harness calls it TPOT); GuideLLM's own TPOT counts the first token and records no mean, so its median stands for it. Only the development split's train and validation points are simulated; the test split is withheld. Mean TTFT is biased high for reasons not yet explained.
